commands: for _, entry in ipairs(vars.gear.spells.buff_overlays) do if entry.buff and entry.pre and entry.when and hasBuff(entry.buff) and evaluateAllConditions(entry.when) then equipMany(entry.pre); if equipment_set and equipment_set.meta and equipment_set.meta.stop then stopEvent(); break end end end

for _, entry in ipairs(vars.gear.spells.buff_overlays) do if entry.buff and entry.mid and entry.when and hasBuff(entry.buff) and evaluateAllConditions(entry.when) then equipMany(entry.mid); if equipment_set and equipment_set.meta and equipment_set.meta.stop then stopEvent(); break end end end
